pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: The Mummy restores some health while changing appearance; this is a native transition rather than evidence of complete immunity. Its attack variants inflict different effects including Blindness, Nausea and Poison. Bring milk for effect removal and healing; reassess the threat after a change before closing in.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Its attack variants inflict different effects including Blindness, Nausea and Poison. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Music Disc, Mummy Trophy. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
